page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred lines of title from top to bottom; below them an engraved vignette (woodcut) with a library stamp to its right, not transcribed; then the imprint lines and date at the foot.

main_text.l: Accessit HARMONIA ex Quatuor Euangelistis in Historiam Mortis, Resurrectionis, & Ascensionis Domini: ab eodem Rolloco concinnata & luculenter exposita; INDEX item Analyticus.

page.notes: Engraved vignette between the title and imprint shows a figure pouring from a vessel on an altar-like urn, with a palm tree and a lion, and the motto "IMPLEVIA RECENS SERVABIT ODOREM" around it (partly worn). Oval library stamp at right ("BIBLIOTH. ACADEM. LAUSAN.", with shield "LIBERTATE ET PATRIÆ") is not transcribed. Long s is rendered as s throughout; the ornament line under the imprint is not text. Several letters in the title are worn and read from context.
